notes: Approved items were not altered. Each replacement has grade-relevant original wording and three distinct MCQ options. These are candidate alternatives pending teacher approval; none was copied verbatim from the textbooks.

changes.topic: Team Together Oman 6A — school magazine and communication
changes.old: I took a bottle of water ___ I would not feel thirsty during the trip.
changes.replacement: Our class sent a message to the school magazine ___ we wanted to share our ideas.

changes.old: ___ the weather was very hot, the students completed their walk.
changes.replacement: First, we bought tickets for the aquarium. What happened next?

changes.old: The students practised for two weeks. ___, they performed confidently at the festival.
changes.replacement: We packed our suitcases in the evening. ___, we travelled to the airport early the next morning.

changes.topic: Team Together Oman 8A — Our planet: survey / report
changes.old: You will not finish the science project on time ___ you share the tasks fairly.
changes.replacement: First, our group chose an endangered animal to study. ___, we collected information about its habitat.

changes.topic: Team Together Oman 8A — Adventure sports: brochure
changes.old: The first island has sandy beaches, ___ the second has steep rocky cliffs.
changes.replacement: Choose the sentence that best follows this opening of a brochure: 'Sandboarding is an exciting adventure sport in Oman.'

changes.topic: Team Together Oman 8A — Spend or save?: informal email reply
changes.old: The team checked every source carefully. ___, their report contained fewer errors.
changes.replacement: Choose the sentence that best completes an informal email: 'Thanks for inviting me to your shopping trip on Friday.'

changes.topic: English for Me 9A — Writers and Writing
changes.old: ___ the journey was difficult, the volunteers continued helping the villagers.
changes.replacement: Choose the best next sentence in a short story: 'When I opened my notebook, I found a letter inside.'

changes.topic: English for Me 9A — Writers and Writing
changes.old: The beach looked clean from a distance. ___, the students found plastic under the rocks.
changes.replacement: The writer planned the beginning and ending of her story. ___, she wrote the first draft.

changes.topic: English for Me 10A — Climate Change: effects and opinion writing
changes.old: The research team can use the survey results ___ the participants have agreed to share their answers.
changes.replacement: Choose the sentence that best follows: 'Plastic waste is becoming a serious problem for marine life.'

changes.topic: English for Me 10A — Climate Change: cause and effect
changes.old: Wind turbines need moving air, ___ solar panels depend on sunlight.
changes.replacement: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases. ___, the Earth's temperature can rise over time.
